_source.title: 设置属性状态：特殊焊盘外形
_source.remarks.text.0: 设置特殊焊盘外形时将会联动设置部分其它属性状态：
_source.remarks.text.1: 1. 焊盘外形属性将被清空

title: Set the property state: special pad shape
remarks.text.0: When setting the special pad shape, some other property states will be set in conjunction:
remarks.text.1: 1. The pad shape property will be cleared
